name: ast-tree
_comment: TextMate grammar for NCC's tree-view pretty printer (src/pretty.rs) covering --parse, --validate, --tacky and --codegen output. Scope names are chosen to track the vitesse-dark colour roles documented at the top of src/pretty.rs. Earlier patterns win, so payload-carrying and size markers are matched before bare keywords.

patterns.comment: Comment lines
patterns.name: comment.line.ast-tree

patterns.comment: Trailing annotations (e.g. `Copy a -> b   # Store result`). Matched before the keyword rules so words inside a comment (like the legacy `Store`) are not mis-highlighted as instructions.
patterns.name: comment.line.ast-tree

patterns.comment: Box-drawing characters used for the tree
patterns.name: punctuation.tree.ast-tree

patterns.comment: TACKY/codegen dataflow arrow (src -> dst)
patterns.name: punctuation.arrow.ast-tree

patterns.comment: Assembly operand size marker <L> (longword) / <Q> (quadword) / <D> (double)
patterns.name: storage.modifier.size.ast-tree

patterns.comment: Imm(<int>) immediate operand. Keyword coloured teal (constant.numeric) so the immediate reads as one constant together with its number.
Stack(<offset>) operand
Pseudo(<name>) operand — pseudo-register (pre-allocation virtual register). Keyword shares the indigo register colour since it is register-class, not memory.
Data(<name>) operand — static/global symbol. Keyword tan (memory); the global name uses the olive names colour (a global name is a name), avoiding a clash with the control-flow green.

Parser/validated Constant literal. Matches both the current typed form Constant(Int(0)) / Long / UInt / ULong / Double and the older bare form Constant(0) (blog snippets are pinned to the compiler version each post covers, so both formats persist). Teal (constant.numeric) so parser constants join the immediate/number 'constant' family across all stages, instead of the green that clashed with control-flow.
patterns.name: constant.numeric.constant.ast-tree

patterns.comment: TACKY Const debug value: ConstInt/ConstLong/ConstUInt/ConstULong/ConstDouble(...)
patterns.name: constant.numeric.ast-tree

patterns.comment: Static initializer value: IntInit/LongInit/UIntInit/ULongInit/DoubleInit(...)
patterns.name: constant.numeric.ast-tree

patterns.comment: Identifier("name") leaf
patterns.name: entity.name.function.ast-tree

patterns.comment: Label(<target>) TACKY/codegen instruction with its label payload
FunctionDefinition: <name> header (TACKY/codegen)
StaticVariable: <name> header

CPU registers (System V scratch/arg set + SSE XMM). Matched BEFORE the arrow-target rule so a register on the right of `->` (e.g. `Mov R10 -> AX`) is coloured as a register, not mis-scoped as a jump label. Indigo gives registers their own hue, clearly separated from teal immediates/numbers and warm tan memory operands (Stack/Data).
patterns.name: type.identifier.register.ast-tree

patterns.comment: Renamed locals / temporaries: name.<n>. Dusty-rose (the best clean/unstyled hue this warm theme offers that is distinct from instruction gold / memory tan; the cooler options in vitesse-dark all carry bold/italic diff-markup styling). Matched BEFORE the arrow-target rule so a temporary destination (`Copy x -> temp.1`) gets the same colour as when it appears as a source — otherwise the same variable renders two different colours. Real jump targets (else_label, end_label) have no .N suffix, so they still fall through to the arrow-target rule and stay label-coloured.
patterns.name: string.other.temporary.ast-tree

patterns.comment: Jump / branch target following an arrow
patterns.name: entity.name.label.ast-tree

patterns.comment: FunCall / Call instruction followed by its callee name
Top-level / declaration nodes (teal)
patterns.name: entity.name.class.ast-tree

patterns.comment: TACKY & codegen instructions and parser/validated expression nodes (teal)
patterns.name: support.function.ast-tree

patterns.comment: Older-form instructions NOT emitted by the current NCC. Blog snippets are pinned to the compiler version each post covers, so this output is permanent (not a snippet to regenerate). Today's compiler lowers stack allocation to `Binary<Q> Sub Imm(n) -> SP` instead of AllocateStack/DeallocateStack; the grammar must highlight both across the post history.
patterns.name: support.function.ast-tree

patterns.comment: Statement / control-flow nodes (teal-green)
patterns.name: keyword.control.ast-tree

patterns.comment: Storage class / linkage markers
patterns.name: storage.modifier.ast-tree

patterns.comment: Types
patterns.name: storage.type.ast-tree

patterns.comment: Operators across parser, TACKY and codegen op enums
patterns.name: keyword.operator.ast-tree

patterns.comment: Condition codes (longer names first; sizes <L>/<Q> already consumed above)
patterns.name: keyword.operator.condition.ast-tree

patterns.comment: Branch labels carried inline, e.g. [label: 0] or [break_loop.0]
patterns.name: entity.name.label.ast-tree

patterns.comment: Child field labels (uncoloured in the printer; highlighted here for readability)
patterns.name: variable.parameter.label.ast-tree

patterns.comment: Vector length header, e.g. [3]
patterns.name: constant.numeric.ast-tree

patterns.comment: Bare integers (offsets, alignments, loop labels)
patterns.name: constant.numeric.ast-tree

patterns.comment: Any remaining quoted string
patterns.name: string.quoted.double.ast-tree
